title: Merge fold never consumes strokes under a new fill — brush Paint Normal (and any fill commit) leaves covered lines intact, unlike Flash 8
description:
VERIFIED with repro. In Flash 8 merge drawing, artwork drawn ON TOP replaces what is beneath — including STROKES: painting with the Brush in Paint Normal over a pencil line erases the covered line segments (this is exactly why Paint Fills / Paint Behind / Paint Inside exist: they are the modes that leave lines unaffected). Drawing a plain fill (oval/rect, no stroke) over a line then deselecting removes the covered stroke run too.

CURRENT BEHAVIOR (repro on origin/main b4430b6): line stroke (0,50)->(200,50) folded with a red fill rect 50..150 x 30..70 via planarMergeCommit -> the merged read-back still contains the FULL stroke: 100px of covered stroke segments (midpoints inside the ribbon) survive and render ON TOP of the new fill (renderer draws fills then strokes). Nothing in the fold (engine/planar/merge.ts foldShapeIntoLayer / build.ts) or the read-back (query.ts planarShapeToShape) ever drops a lineStyle based on draw-order coverage — top-wins is implemented for FACE fills only (assignFaceFillsBySampling), never for stroke half-edges.

WHY IT MATTERS: brush strokes cannot cover/replace pencil lines (a core Flash 8 workflow: paint over sketch lines); combined with task 1429 the paint modes are indistinguishable wrt lines; SWF output shows lines bleeding through fills that should have consumed them.

SUGGESTED FIX: in the fold, apply draw-order top-wins to stroke half-edges the same way faces get it: after building the arrangement, for each stroked half-edge whose curve midpoint is covered by a LATER-drawn fill region (the same fillRegions list build.ts already collects, with draw-order indices), clear its lineStyle at read-back (edgeFilter). Careful scoping: only fills drawn AFTER the stroke consume it; a stroke drawn after/over a fill still splits the fill (P2 line-splits-fill, task 1320, must stay intact); paint modes Fills/Behind/Selection/Inside must pass a preserve-lines flag (their clipped ribbons commit through the same fold — see commitBrushStrokeToTimeline, model/timeline.ts:1160-1204).

ACCEPTANCE: (a) unit: fold(line, then fill-over) -> no stroke segment midpoint inside the fill survives; segments outside survive; (b) unit: fold(fill, then line-over) unchanged (line splits fill, P2 tests green); (c) brush Paint Normal over a pencil line erases the covered run; Paint Fills over the same leaves it (with 1429); (d) merge-drawing-oracle stays diff=0 and a new oracle case renders identically stage vs Ruffle.

CAUTION: this is a deliberate merge-semantics change on the oracle-verified kernel's read-back layer — keep it in the fold/emit filters, not the DCEL. Related: 1320 (line-splits-fill), 1429 (Paint Fills), 1421. Found by brush/eraser Flash-8 fidelity audit; ground truth = Flash 8 Using Flash 'Brush tool modifiers' + merge-drawing overlap rules.
